shots.vo: Quick question. When someone in your town searches for what you sell... do they find you?
Searchers pick from the first few results.
SEO is making sure the people searching for what you sell can find you. And that what they find makes them call.
That's my job. I've worked on search for almost twenty years.
I owned a web development agency. I worked inside a marketing department. And I ran SEO for Espresso.
Local search. Neighborhood pages about real places. A steady way to earn reviews. And content in your voice.
Proof? I bought Garage Door Pro Services in Southern Utah, and took it to number one within three months.
I grew its reviews. I built neighborhood pages and a checklist. Once it was outranking everyone, I sold it to a competitor.
How long will it take for you? It depends on your market. I'll tell you plainly what I think is realistic.
So let's start with a call about your business. Seth Shoultes dot com.
